summary: Preserve storage writer gates and replica records across privacy floor 28

replay.detail: No replay or history rewrite is required.

schema.detail: Privacy upgrades retain existing reference-writer activation without enabling it. Version-27 stores receive the valid_records_gone meta marker before advancing to 28; other supported stores keep valid replica records. First deletion at version 28 or above writes the marker without lowering user_version; earlier stores retain main's version-27 deletion fence.

rules.detail: Thread privacy and writer-readiness approvals are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The version-28 privacy fence is independent of the record-retention format. Published attention retains raw discussion context before recipient projection and refreshes resources when that context changes.

downtime.detail: No deployment or writer activation is performed.

recovery.detail: Use compatible forward repair; never lower the privacy fence.
